title: Bigger tax-free gifts to family

ask.helpsFamilyWithMoney: Do you sometimes help your children or grandchildren with money?

message: Since this year you can give each person gifts worth less than {limit} € in total every {years} years without gift tax. Before, the limit was {oldLimit} €. The limit counts per giver, so two grandparents can each give.
explain: The limit is per receiver and per giver: gifts from the same giver to the same person over {years} years are added together, and gift tax applies only from {limit} € upwards. If the customer names an amount, say in words whether it is below {limit} € or not. Never work out the tax itself; for that, point to the Tax Administration (vero.fi).
_note: Student concept. Figures read on the official source on the checkedAt date; not tax or legal advice.
